"""Apply underlining to all headline paragraphs in unpacked quarterly_report.docx."""
import re
import sys

DOCXML = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

with open(DOCXML, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    text = fh.read()

# Identify headline paragraphs: <w:p> whose <w:pPr> contains a heading or Title style.
# Collect the style values used.
style_vals = sorted(set(re.findall(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]*)"', text)))
print("Styles used:", style_vals)

# Count headline paragraphs for each style of interest
for sv in style_vals:
    if "Heading" in sv or sv == "Title":
        n = len(re.findall(r'<w:pStyle w:val="%s"/>' % re.escape(sv), text))
        print(f"Style {sv}: {n} paragraphs")

print("OK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect the unpacked quarterly_report.docx to find headline paragraphs."""
import re
import sys

path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    xml = f.read()

# Find all paragraphs and report their style and first text content
paras = re.findall(r"<w:p\b.*?</w:p>", xml, re.DOTALL)
print(f"Total paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = ""
    m = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    if m:
        style = m.group(1)
    texts = re.findall(r"<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>", p)
    content = "".join(texts)
    if style.startswith("Heading") or style in ("Title", "Subtitle") or "heading" in style.lower():
        print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={content!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headlines in the unpacked quarterly_report.docx OOXML content.

Headlines are non-empty paragraphs whose text contains at least one letter and
no lowercase letters (all-caps section titles such as "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY").
Each headline run gets <w:u w:val="single"/> added to its run properties.

The document XML is ASCII-encoded with numeric character references (e.g.
•), so the serialized DOM is re-encoded with xmlcharrefreplace to
preserve that style and keep the XML declaration (encoding="ascii") valid.
"""
import io
import os
import re
import sys

UNPACKED = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "unpacked"
DOC_PATH = os.path.join(UNPACKED, "word", "document.xml")

try:
    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:
    from xml.dom import minidom


def paragraph_text(p):
    return "".join(
        t.firstChild.nodeValue
        for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeValue
    )


def is_headline(text):
    s = text.strip()
    if not s:
        return False
    return any(c.isalpha() for c in s) and not any(c.islower() for c in s)


def add_underline(p, dom):
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        rpr = rprs[0] if rprs else None
        if rpr is None:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
            u = dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)


dom = minidom.parse(DOC_PATH)
headlines = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    text = paragraph_text(p)
    if is_headline(text):
        add_underline(p, dom)
        headlines.append(text)

buf = io.StringIO()
dom.writexml(buf, addindent="  ", newl="\n")
xml_out = re.sub(
    r"^<\?xml[^>]*\?>",
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>',
    buf.getvalue(),
    count=1,
)
with open(DOC_PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
    f.write(xml_out.encode("ascii", errors="xmlcharrefreplace").decode("ascii"))

print("Underlined %d headlines:" % len(headlines))
for h in headlines:
    print(" -", h)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headline paragraphs in unpacked quarterly_report.docx.

Headlines are the all-caps section title lines (e.g. "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
"FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS", ...). For each headline paragraph, <w:u w:val="single"/>
is added to every run's run properties, preserving all text and other content.

Works with the standard library only (no lxml dependency).
"""
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W_NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'

# Namespaces declared on the document root, registered so serialization
# keeps the original prefixes (w:, r:, o:, v:, wp:, w10:, ve:).
NAMESPACES = {
    've': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006',
    'o': 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'v': 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml',
    'wp': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing',
    'w10': 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word',
    'w': W_NS,
}
for prefix, uri in NAMESPACES.items():
    ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

W_P = '{%s}' % W_NS


def paragraph_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.iter(W_P + 't'):
        if t.text:
            parts.append(t.text)
    return ''.join(parts)


def is_headline(txt):
    letters = [c for c in txt if c.isalpha()]
    if not letters or len(txt) > 80:
        return False
    return all(c.isupper() for c in letters)


def main():
    unpacked = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'unpacked'
    path = unpacked + '/word/document.xml'
    tree = ET.parse(path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    headline_count = 0
    run_count = 0

    for p in root.iter(W_P + 'p'):
        if not is_headline(paragraph_text(p)):
            continue
        headline_count += 1
        for r in p.iter(W_P + 'r'):
            rPr = r.find(W_P + 'rPr')
            if rPr is None:
                rPr = ET.SubElement(r, W_P + 'rPr')
                r.remove(rPr)
                r.insert(0, rPr)
            # Drop any pre-existing underline directive on this run.
            for u in list(rPr.iter(W_P + 'u')):
                rPr.remove(u)
            u = ET.SubElement(rPr, W_P + 'u')
            u.set(W_P + 'val', 'single')
            # Move <w:u> to its schema-correct position: after the run
            # property elements that legally precede it.
            rPr.remove(u)
            anchor = None
            for tag in ('w:szCs', 'w:sz', 'w:highlight', 'w:position', 'w:kern',
                        'w:w', 'w:spacing', 'w:color', 'w:webHidden',
                        'w:vanish', 'w:snapToGrid', 'w:noProof', 'w:imprint',
                        'w:emboss', 'w:outline', 'w:dstrike', 'w:strike',
                        'w:smallCaps', 'w:caps', 'w:iCs', 'w:i', 'w:bCs',
                        'w:b', 'w:rFonts', 'w:rStyle'):
                found = rPr.findall(W_P + tag[2:])
                if found:
                    anchor = found[-1]
            if anchor is not None:
                idx = list(rPr).index(anchor) + 1
                rPr.insert(idx, u)
            else:
                rPr.append(u)
            run_count += 1

    tree.write(path, encoding='ascii', xml_declaration=True)
    print(f'Headlines underlined: {headline_count}; runs updated: {run_count}')
    print('Wrote updated OOXML back to unpacked directory.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    return ''.join(parts)


def is_headline(txt):

    if not letters or len(txt) > 80:
        return False
    return all(c.isupper() for c in letters)

    unpacked = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'unpacked'
    path = unpacked + '/word/document.xml'
    tree = ET.parse(path)
    root = tree.getroot()

"""Underline all headlines in the unpacked quarterly_report.docx OOXML content.

Headlines are non-empty paragraphs whose text contains at least one letter and
no lowercase letters (all-caps section titles such as "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY").
Each headline run gets <w:u w:val="single"/> added to its run properties.

The document XML is ASCII-encoded with numeric character references (e.g.
•), so the serialized DOM is re-encoded with xmlcharrefreplace to
preserve that style and keep the XML declaration (encoding="ascii") valid.
"""
import io
import os
import re
import sys

UNPACKED = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "unpacked"
DOC_PATH = os.path.join(UNPACKED, "word", "document.xml")

try:
    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:
    from xml.dom import minidom


def paragraph_text(p):
    return "".join(
        t.firstChild.nodeValue
        for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeValue
    )


def is_headline(text):
    s = text.strip()
    if not s:
        return False
    return any(c.isalpha() for c in s) and not any(c.islower() for c in s)


def add_underline(p, dom):
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        rpr = rprs[0] if rprs else None
        if rpr is None:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        if not rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
            u = dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)


dom = minidom.parse(DOC_PATH)
headlines = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    text = paragraph_text(p)
    if is_headline(text):
        add_underline(p, dom)
        headlines.append(text)

buf = io.StringIO()
dom.writexml(buf, addindent="  ", newl="\n")
xml_out = re.sub(
    r"^<\?xml[^>]*\?>",
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>',
    buf.getvalue(),
    count=1,
)
with open(DOC_PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
    f.write(xml_out.encode("ascii", errors="xmlcharrefreplace").decode("ascii"))

print("Underlined %d headlines:" % len(headlines))
for h in headlines:
    print(" -", h)

                rPr.append(u)
            run_count += 1

    tree.write(path, encoding='ascii', xml_declaration=True)
    print(f'Headlines underlined: {headline_count}; runs updated: {run_count}')
    print('Wrote updated OOXML back to unpacked directory.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
